national_questions.qe: What is the name of the AI‑based tool launched by SEBI to detect financial fraud on social media?
national_questions.qh: वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी का पता लगाने के लिए सेबी द्वारा लॉन्च किए गए एआई‑आधारित टूल का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because SEBI announced the AI tool named ‘Sudarshan’ for multi‑stage fraud detection.
• Option A is Incorrect; ‘Suraksha’ is not the name of the tool.
• Option C is Incorrect; ‘Samved’ is unrelated to SEBI’s AI initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect; ‘Sanchalak’ is not the tool launched by SEBI.

national_questions.qe: Which of the following projects was NOT inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi at Ekta Nagar on Rashtriya Ekta Diwas?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय एकता दिवस पर प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी द्वारा एकता नगर में किस परियोजना का उद्घाटन नहीं किया गया?
oe: Artificial Rain Forest with a circular glass skywalk
oh: वृत्ताकार कांच के स्काईवॉक के साथ कृत्रिम रेन फॉरेस्ट
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because a new metro line was not among the projects listed for inauguration.
• Option A is Incorrect; the 12‑acre artificial Rain Forest with glass skywalk was inaugurated.
• Option B is Incorrect; Vaman Vriksha Vatika was part of the inaugurated projects.
• Option D is Incorrect; Ekta Cruise was also inaugurated at the event.

national_questions.qe: Where is India’s first indigenous high‑speed bullet train set “B28” being manufactured?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला स्वदेशी हाई‑स्पीड बुलेट ट्रेन सेट “B28” कहाँ निर्मित हो रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the B28 set is being built at BEML’s Bengaluru workshop in collaboration with ICF.
• Option A is Incorrect because ICF is only a partner for design and testing, not the primary manufacturing site.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Rail Coach Factory, Kapurthala manufactures conventional coaches, not the bullet‑train set.
• Option D is Incorrect because Alstom does not have a manufacturing unit for the indigenous B28 project.

national_questions.qe: Which former Central Vigilance Commissioner was appointed chairperson of the High‑Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat?
national_questions.qh: विकसित भारत के लिए बैंकिंग पर हाई‑लेवल कमेटी के चेयरपर्सन के रूप में किस पूर्व केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयुक्त को नियुक्त किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the committee was chaired by former CVC Suresh N. Patel.
• Option B is Incorrect; Raghuram Rajan is a former RBI Governor, not appointed to this committee.
• Option C is Incorrect; Urjit Patel is also a former RBI Governor, not the chair.
• Option D is Incorrect; Shaktikanta Das is the current RBI Governor, not a committee member.

national_questions.qe: What was the amount of the additional advance tax devolution released by the Union Finance Ministry to states on 31 October 2026?
national_questions.qh: 31 अक्टूबर 2026 को केंद्र वित्त मंत्रालय द्वारा राज्यों को जारी किए गए अतिरिक्त अग्रिम कर हस्तांतरण की राशि क्या थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Ministry released an additional ₹1,09,019 crore on the stated date.
• Option A is Incorrect; ₹85,000 crore does not match the announced figure.
• Option C is Incorrect; ₹1,25,500 crore exceeds the actual amount.
• Option D is Incorrect; ₹95,750 crore is not the amount disclosed.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of the insecticide molecule that is India’s first indigenously discovered and commercialised as Pioxazon?
national_questions.qh: भारत में पहली बार स्वदेशी रूप से खोजी गई और पियोक्साज़ोन के रूप में व्यावसायीकरण की गई कीटाणुनाशक अणु का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Pioxaniliprole is the first insecticide molecule discovered in India and launched commercially as Pioxazon for rice, maize and Bengal gram.
• Option B is Incorrect because Chlorpyrifos is an imported insecticide, not an indigenous discovery.
• Option C is Incorrect because Imidacloprid is a synthetic insecticide developed abroad.
• Option D is Incorrect because Cypermethrin is a widely used synthetic insecticide, not the first Indian‑discovered molecule.

national_questions.qe: Under which central scheme was Khaira village in Chhattisgarh declared India’s first 100% solar village?
national_questions.qh: छत्तीसगढ़ के खैरा गांव को भारत का पहला 100% सौर गांव घोषित करने के लिए कौन सी केंद्रीय योजना लागू की गई?
oe: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana
oh: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्राम ज्योति योजना
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Khaira village achieved 100% rooftop solar coverage under the PM Surya Ghar Yojana (Muft Bijli Yojana).
• Option A is Incorrect as Saubhagya focuses on household electrification, not solar rooftop deployment.
• Option C is Incorrect; Ujjwal Bharat is a broader rural electrification program.
• Option D is Incorrect; Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana deals with power supply to villages, not solar installations.

national_questions.qe: Which state government signed an MoU with Ion Beam Applications SA subsidiary to set up India’s first public proton beam therapy centre?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी राज्य सरकार ने आयन बीम एप्लिकेशन्स SA की सहायक कंपनी के साथ भारत के पहले सार्वजनिक प्रोटॉन बीम थेरेपी केंद्र की स्थापना के लिए समझौता ज्ञापन (MoU) पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Assam government signed the MoU with Ion Beam Applications SA subsidiary for a Rs 600 crore public proton beam therapy unit in Guwahati.
• Option A is Incorrect; Kerala has not announced such a MoU.
• Option B is Incorrect; Maharashtra’s initiatives are unrelated to this specific public proton therapy project.
• Option D is Incorrect; Tamil Nadu has private proton therapy centres but no public MoU of this nature.

national_questions.qe: By which target year has the Union Ministry of Home Affairs planned to establish Foreigners Regional Registration Offices (FRROs) across all state capitals in India?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय गृह मंत्रालय ने भारत के सभी राज्यों की राजधानियों में विदेशी क्षेत्रीय पंजीकरण कार्यालय (FRRO) स्थापित करने का लक्ष्य किस वर्ष तक निर्धारित किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Union Home Minister Amit Shah directed the establishment of Foreigners Regional Registration Offices (FRROs) in all state capitals across India by 2027 to manage post-arrival tracking, visa extensions, and consular oversight.
• Option A is Incorrect because 2025 is not the target year set by the MHA.
• Option C is Incorrect because 2030 is beyond the established policy roadmap.
• Option D is Incorrect because 2028 is not the official timeline set for expanding FRRO coverage.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian state has become the first in the country to procure 24 agricultural crops at the Minimum Support Price (MSP)?
national_questions.qh: न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) पर 24 कृषि फसलों की खरीद करने वाला भारत का पहला राज्य कौन सा बन गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Haryana became the first state in India to procure 24 crops at the Minimum Support Price (MSP), as highlighted during the 60th Haryana Day celebrations.
• Option A is Incorrect because Punjab primarily procures staple grains like wheat and paddy under central MSP allocations.
• Option B is Incorrect because Madhya Pradesh introduced price deficiency payment systems like Bhavantar Bhugtan Yojna rather than full MSP procurement of 24 crops.
• Option C is Incorrect because Uttar Pradesh does not procure 24 distinct agricultural crops at MSP.

national_questions.qe: Which public sector manufacturing company is producing India's first indigenously designed high-speed bullet train trainset, designated as 'B28'?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले स्वदेशी रूप से डिजाइन किए गए हाई-स्पीड बुलेट ट्रेन ट्रेनसेट, जिसे 'B28' नाम दिया गया है, का निर्माण किस सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र की निर्माण कंपनी द्वारा किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because India's first indigenously designed high-speed bullet train trainset (designated as B28) is being manufactured by BEML at its facility in Bengaluru for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor.
• Option B is Incorrect because BHEL is a major heavy electrical equipment manufacturer and is not manufacturing the B28 high-speed trainset.
• Option C is Incorrect because HAL specializes in aerospace and defense manufacturing.
• Option D is Incorrect because Titagarh Rail Systems manufactures metro coaches and freight wagons, whereas BEML Bengaluru was selected for the B28 bullet train trainset.

national_questions.qe: Who won India's first-ever medal in swimming at the Youth Olympic Games by securing a bronze in the girls' 100-metre freestyle event?
national_questions.qh: युवा ओलंपिक खेलों में लड़कियों की 100 मीटर फ्रीस्टाइल स्पर्धा में कांस्य पदक जीतकर तैराकी में भारत का पहला पदक किसने जीता?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because swimmer Dhinidhi Desinghu made history by winning India's first-ever Youth Olympic Games swimming medal, securing a bronze in the girls' 100m freestyle at Dakar 2026 with a time of 56.27 seconds.
• Option A is Incorrect because Maana Patel is an Olympic backstroke swimmer, not the Youth Olympic bronze medalist.
• Option C is Incorrect because Srihari Nataraj is a prominent male Olympic swimmer from India.
• Option D is Incorrect because Shivani Kataria represented India at the 2016 Rio Olympics in women's freestyle swimming.

national_questions.qe: At which location is NTPC setting up India's first ceramic-based concentrated solar power (CSP) project designed to store heat and generate power at night?
national_questions.qh: NTPC किस स्थान पर ऊष्मा को संग्रहीत करने और रात में बिजली उत्पन्न करने के लिए डिज़ाइन की गई भारत की पहली सिरेमिक-आधारित संकेंद्रित सौर ऊर्जा (CSP) परियोजना स्थापित कर रहा है?
oe: Kurnool Ultra Mega Solar Park, Andhra Pradesh
oh: कुरनूल अल्ट्रा मेगा सोलर पार्क, आंध्र प्रदेश
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because NTPC is setting up India's first 320 kW ceramic-based concentrated solar power (CSP) pilot project at Bhadla Solar Park in Rajasthan using high-temperature ceramic modules to generate electricity during the night.
• Option A is Incorrect because Pavagada Solar Park is located in Tumakuru district, Karnataka, and is not the host location for this pilot project.
• Option B is Incorrect because Charanka Solar Park is situated in Gujarat.
• Option D is Incorrect because Kurnool Ultra Mega Solar Park is located in Andhra Pradesh.

national_questions.qe: Where is India's first public-sector Proton Therapy Centre for advanced cancer treatment being established?
national_questions.qh: उन्नत कैंसर उपचार के लिए भारत का पहला सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र का प्रोटॉन थेरेपी केंद्र कहाँ स्थापित किया जा रहा है?
oe: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi
Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh
Gauhati Medical College and Hospital (GMCH), Assam
oh: अखिल भारतीय आयुर्विज्ञान संस्थान (AIIMS), नई दिल्ली
स्नातकोत्तर चिकित्सा शिक्षा एवं अनुसंधान संस्थान (PGIMER), चंडीगढ़
गुवाहाटी मेडिकल कॉलेज एवं अस्पताल (GMCH), असम
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because India's first public-sector Proton Therapy Centre is being established at Gauhati Medical College and Hospital (GMCH) in Assam at a total project cost of ₹600 crore under the World Bank-assisted ASSIST initiative.
• Option A is Incorrect because AIIMS New Delhi is a premier medical institution, but is not establishing India's first government proton therapy centre under this project.
• Option B is Incorrect because Tata Memorial Hospital in Mumbai is a comprehensive cancer centre, but the first public-sector proton therapy facility is being set up at GMCH Guwahati.
• Option C is Incorrect because PGIMER Chandigarh is a major tertiary institute in North India, not the location for this proton beam facility.

national_questions.qe: In which neighboring country is the 'Gelephu Mindfulness City' project located, where 108 Stupas were recently consecrated along the Aie (Mau) River?
national_questions.qh: किस पड़ोसी देश में 'गेलेफू माइंडफुलनेस सिटी' परियोजना स्थित है, जहाँ हाल ही में ऐ (माउ) नदी के किनारे 108 स्तूपों का प्राण-प्रतिष्ठापन किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the King of Bhutan dedicated Stupa number 76 to Prime Minister Narendra Modi during the consecration of 108 Stupas in Gelephu Mindfulness City along the Aie (Mau) River in Bhutan.
• Option A is Incorrect because Nepal is not the host nation for the Gelephu Mindfulness City project.
• Option B is Incorrect because Sri Lanka is an island nation in the Indian Ocean, unrelated to Gelephu.
• Option C is Incorrect because Myanmar shares eastern borders with India and is not involved in the Gelephu initiative.

national_questions.qe: Which international grouping is negotiating a Comprehensive Free Trade Agreement (FTA) with India, targeting full entry into force by mid-2027?
national_questions.qh: किस अंतर्राष्ट्रीय समूह के साथ भारत एक व्यापक मुक्त व्यापार समझौते (FTA) पर बातचीत कर रहा है, जिसे मध्य-2027 तक लागू करने का लक्ष्य रखा गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because high-level trade discussions were held in Brussels between India and the European Union (EU) to review FTA implementation, targeted for entry into force by mid-2027.
• Option B is Incorrect because ASEAN already signed an FTA with India in 2009.
• Option C is Incorrect because GCC trade negotiations are a separate initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect because the African Union is a continental bloc not engaged in these specific bilateral FTA talks.

national_questions.qe: India's first indigenous hydrogen-powered train has been launched on which railway section of Northern Railway?
national_questions.qh: उत्तर रेलवे के किस रेलवे खंड पर भारत की पहली स्वदेशी हाइड्रोजन-संचालित ट्रेन शुरू की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India's first indigenous hydrogen-powered train operates on the Jind–Sonipat section in Haryana under Northern Railway, utilizing a Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell.
• Option A is Incorrect because Kalka–Shimla is a narrow-gauge heritage route.
• Option C is Incorrect because Darjeeling Himalayan Railway is a UNESCO site using traditional steam/diesel engines.
• Option D is Incorrect because Nilgiri Mountain Railway is located in Tamil Nadu.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Ministry is the nodal agency conducting India's first fully digital population count under Census 2026?
national_questions.qh: जनगणना 2026 के तहत भारत की पहली पूर्णतः डिजिटल जनसंख्या गणना आयोजित करने के लिए कौन सा केंद्रीय मंत्रालय नोडल एजेंसी है?
oe: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India operates under the Ministry of Home Affairs, which conducts the digital Census 2026.
• Option A is Incorrect because MoSPI handles NSO sample surveys, not the decennial census.
• Option B is Incorrect because MeitY provides general IT framework support but is not the executive agency.
• Option D is Incorrect because Housing and Urban Affairs deals strictly with urban governance and housing policies.

national_questions.qe: Which Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) is manufacturing India's first indigenous high-speed bullet train (B28) at its Aditya Plant in Bengaluru?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र का उपक्रम (PSU) बेंगलुरु स्थित अपने आदित्य संयंत्र में भारत की पहली स्वदेशी हाई-स्पीड बुलेट ट्रेन (B28) का निर्माण कर रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because BEML (Bharat Earth Movers Limited) is manufacturing India's first indigenous bullet train (B28) at its Aditya Plant in Bengaluru for the Mumbai–Ahmedabad corridor.
• Option A is Incorrect because BHEL manufactures heavy electrical equipment and locomotives but not the B28 bullet train.
• Option B is Incorrect because ICF Chennai manufactures Vande Bharat express trains.
• Option C is Incorrect because HAL is an aerospace defense PSU.

national_questions.qe: Which two Indian public‑sector units are jointly constructing the body frame of India’s first indigenous bullet train (B28)?
national_questions.qh: भारत की पहली स्वदेशी बुलेट ट्रेन (B28) के बॉडी फ्रेम का निर्माण करने वाले दो भारतीय सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के इकाइयों का नाम क्या है?
oe: ICF and Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
oh: ICF और भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the bullet‑train (B28) body frame is being built jointly by Integral Coach Factory, Chennai and BEML, Bengaluru, as per the official project update.
• Option B is Incorrect; Indian Railways is the operator and DRDO is not a manufacturing partner for the train body.
• Option C is Incorrect; HAL works on aerospace projects, not high‑speed rail bodies.
• Option D is Incorrect; ISRO is not involved in rail‑coach manufacturing.

national_questions.qe: When is the first operational section (Surat–Vapi) of the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad High‑Speed Rail corridor scheduled to be inaugurated?
national_questions.qh: मुंबई‑अहमदाबाद हाई‑स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर के पहले परिचालन खंड (सूरत‑वापी) का उद्घाटन कब निर्धारित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because official project reports state that the Surat–Vapi section will be opened to traffic in August 2027.
• Option A is Incorrect; no official timeline places the inauguration in December 2026.
• Option C is Incorrect; the projected date is earlier than March 2028.
• Option D is Incorrect; June 2027 is not the announced month for the first section’s opening.

national_questions.qe: Which initiative was highlighted by the Union Defence Minister during the third Delhi Defence Dialogue?
national_questions.qh: तीसरे दिल्ली डिफेंस डायलॉग के दौरान केंद्रीय रक्षा मंत्री द्वारा किस पहल को प्रमुखता दी गई?
oe: Corporatisation of the Ordnance Factory Board into seven Defence PSUs
Launch of an indigenous fighter jet
Establishment of a new naval base on the east coast
oh: ऑर्डनेंस फ़ैक्टरी बोर्ड का सात रक्षा पीएसयू में निगमित होना
पूर्वी तट पर नया नौसैनिक अड्डा स्थापित करना
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because the Defence Industrial Corridors were mentioned but not the sole highlighted initiative.
• Option B is Correct because the Minister specifically highlighted the corporatisation of the Ordnance Factory Board into seven Defence PSUs.
• Option C is Incorrect as no launch of a new indigenous fighter jet was announced.
• Option D is Incorrect; no new naval base was part of the dialogue.

national_questions.qe: What was the theme of the Indo‑Pacific Regional Dialogue 2026 held in New Delhi?
national_questions.qh: न्यू दिल्ली में आयोजित इन्डो‑पैसिफिक रीजनल डायलॉग 2026 का थीम क्या था?
oe: Science, Technology and Academic Cooperation in the Indo‑Pacific
Maritime Security and Trade in the Indo‑Pacific
Climate Change and Blue Economy in the Indo‑Pacific
oh: इन्डो‑पैसिफिक में विज्ञान, प्रौद्योगिकी और शैक्षणिक सहयोग
इन्डो‑पैसिफिक में समुद्री सुरक्षा और व्यापार
इन्डो‑पैसिफिक में जलवायु परिवर्तन और ब्लू इकोनॉमी
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the official theme was “Science, Technology and Academic Cooperation in the Indo‑Pacific”.
• Option B is Incorrect; maritime security was discussed but not the declared theme.
• Option C is Incorrect; climate change was a sub‑topic, not the main theme.
• Option D is Incorrect; cybersecurity was not the headline theme.

national_questions.qe: What percentage of the energy requirement for Pune Metro Line 3 is planned to be sourced from solar power?
national_questions.qh: पुणे मेट्रो लाइन 3 की ऊर्जा आवश्यकता का कितना प्रतिशत सौर ऊर्जा से प्राप्त किया जाएगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because the plan is for a higher share than 10 %.
• Option B is Incorrect; 20 % is not the announced figure.
• Option C is Correct as the project will source 30 % of its energy from solar power.
• Option D is Incorrect; 40 % exceeds the stated target.

national_questions.qe: What are the new operating hours of the NSE International Exchange at GIFT City after the recent extension?
national_questions.qh: विस्तार के बाद GIFT सिटी में NSE इंटरनेशनल एक्सचेंज के नए संचालन समय क्या हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the exchange now operates from 3:15 AM to 2:45 AM IST, covering almost a full 24‑hour cycle.
• Option B is Incorrect; the start time is earlier than 5:15 AM.
• Option C is Incorrect; the closing time is later than 5:15 PM.
• Option D is Incorrect; there is a short maintenance window, not a strict 24‑hour continuous run.

national_questions.qe: Under which ministry was the Bengaluru‑Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper train flagged off?
national_questions.qh: बेंगलुरु‑मुंबई वंदे भारत स्लीपर ट्रेन को किस मंत्रालय के तहत ध्वजांकित किया गया?
oe: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
oh: गृह एवं शहरी मामलों का मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the train was flagged off by Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw and belongs to the Ministry of Railways.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways deals with highways, not railway services.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Commerce and Industry is unrelated to passenger train operations.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs does not oversee railway projects.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian state launched the first Silt Management Policy in 2026?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा भारतीय राज्य 2026 में पहला सिल्ट प्रबंधन नीति लॉन्च किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Bihar introduced the Bihar Water Source Restoration and Silt Management Policy 2026, the first such policy in India.
• Option A is Incorrect; Uttar Pradesh has not announced a dedicated silt‑management policy.
• Option C is Incorrect; Maharashtra’s recent initiatives relate to road safety, not silt management.
• Option D is Incorrect; Gujarat has not released a comparable state‑wide silt policy.

national_questions.qe: What is the passenger capacity of India’s first indigenous high‑speed bullet train?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले स्वदेशी हाई‑स्पीड बुलेट ट्रेन की यात्री क्षमता कितनी है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the eight‑coach indigenous bullet train built by BEML will carry 557 passengers.
• Option A is Incorrect; 400 is lower than the announced capacity.
• Option B is Incorrect; 600 exceeds the official figure.
• Option D is Incorrect; 720 is not mentioned in any official release.

national_questions.qe: In which location of Maharashtra will the country's first Road Safety Training and Research Institute be established?
national_questions.qh: महाराष्ट्र में भारत का पहला रोड सुरक्षा प्रशिक्षण एवं अनुसंधान संस्थान किस स्थान पर स्थापित होगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the institute is planned at Saswad in Pune district.
• Option A is Incorrect; while Pune district hosts the project, the specific town is Saswad.
• Option B is Incorrect; Nagpur is not mentioned in the announcement.
• Option C is Incorrect; Nashik is unrelated to this initiative.

national_questions.qe: What is the total grid-scale energy storage capacity targeted for development by 2030–31 under the Viability Gap Funding scheme approved by the Union Cabinet?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल द्वारा स्वीकृत वायबिलिटी गैप फंडिंग (VGF) योजना के तहत वर्ष 2030-31 तक कुल कितनी ग्रिड-स्तरीय ऊर्जा भंडारण क्षमता के विकास का लक्ष्य रखा गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Union Cabinet approved a ₹14,500 crore VGF scheme to develop 92 GWh of grid-scale energy storage capacity by 2030–31 (comprising 60 GWh pumped hydro, 30 GWh battery storage, and 2 GWh emerging tech).
• Option A is Incorrect because 50 GWh does not reflect the total target allocated under the scheme.
• Option B is Incorrect because 75 GWh is less than the approved 92 GWh target.
• Option D is Incorrect because 110 GWh exceeds the approved capacity target.

national_questions.qe: Which premier institution under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports launched the Extramural Research Grant Policy to advance anti-doping research in India?
national_questions.qh: भारत में डोपिंग रोधी अनुसंधान को बढ़ावा देने के लिए युवा कार्यक्रम और खेल मंत्रालय के तहत किस प्रमुख संस्थान ने 'एक्स्ट्राम्यूरल्स रिसर्च ग्रांट पॉलिसी' शुरू की है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Extramural Research Grant Policy was launched by the National Dope Testing Laboratory (NDTL) during the 10th WAADS meeting in New Delhi.
• Option A is Incorrect because SAI manages sports infrastructure and athlete development, not specialized dope testing research grants.
• Option B is Incorrect because NADA handles anti-doping rule enforcement and testing execution, whereas NDTL manages testing laboratory research.
• Option C is Incorrect because the IOA is an administrative governing body for Olympic sports in India.

national_questions.qe: Where is India's first indigenously designed and manufactured high-speed bullet trainset being developed for the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor?
national_questions.qh: मुंबई-अहमदाबाद हाई-स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर के लिए भारत की पहली स्वदेशी रूप से डिजाइन और निर्मित बुलेट ट्रेन का निर्माण कहाँ किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India's first indigenously designed and manufactured bullet trainset is being built at BEML's Bengaluru facility for the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor. The 8-coach trainset is 202 meters long with a design operational speed of 249 km/h.
• Option A is Incorrect because ICF Chennai primarily produces Vande Bharat Express trainsets, not the indigenous bullet train.
• Option C is Incorrect because RCF Kapurthala produces standard LHB coaches and conventional rake variants.
• Option D is Incorrect because MCF Raebareli manufactures conventional passenger coaches and smart coaches.

national_questions.qe: In which city is India's first urban public transport ropeway project being constructed to connect the main railway station with Godowlia Chowk?
national_questions.qh: मुख्य रेलवे स्टेशन को गोदौलिया चौक से जोड़ने के लिए भारत की पहली शहरी सार्वजनिक परिवहन रोपवे परियोजना का निर्माण किस शहर में किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Varanasi (Uttar Pradesh) is developing India's first public transport ropeway project, spanning 4.2 km between Varanasi Cantt Railway Station and Godowlia Chowk, reducing travel time from 45 minutes to 15 minutes.
• Option A is Incorrect because Haridwar operates tourist ropeways (Mansa Devi/Chandi Devi), not an urban mass transit public ropeway network.
• Option B is Incorrect because Shimla uses ropeways for hill connectivity and tourism rather than a dedicated urban mass transit corridor.
• Option D is Incorrect because Dehradun's ropeway project is planned for Mussoorie connectivity, not as the first urban public transport system.

national_questions.qe: Who became the first Indian woman wrestler to win a gold medal at the Senior World Wrestling Championships?
national_questions.qh: विश्व कुश्ती चैंपियनशिप में स्वर्ण पदक जीतने वाली पहली भारतीय महिला पहलवान कौन बनी हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Manisha Bhanwala created history by becoming India's first-ever woman wrestler to win a World Championship gold medal, securing top honors in the 59kg freestyle category in Astana, Kazakhstan.
• Option A is Incorrect because Vinesh Phogat has won multiple World Championship bronze medals, but not a gold.
• Option B is Incorrect because Sakshi Malik is an Olympic bronze medalist (2016) but has not won a World Championship gold.
• Option C is Incorrect because Antim Panghal won World Championship bronze medals and U20 World titles, but not senior gold.

national_questions.qe: Which athlete won India's first-ever Youth Olympic Games medal in Wushu at the 2026 Games in Dakar, Senegal?
national_questions.qh: डकार, सेनेगल में आयोजित 2026 यूथ ओलंपिक खेलों में वुशू (Wushu) में भारत का पहला पदक किस एथलीट ने जीता?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Rajkumari Lanchenbi Chanu won bronze in women's changquan combined, securing India's first-ever Youth Olympic medal in Wushu at Dakar, Senegal, where Wushu debuted as a medal discipline.
• Option B is Incorrect because Naorem Roshibina Devi is a senior Asian Games silver medalist in Wushu, not a Youth Olympian.
• Option C is Incorrect because Yumnam Sanathoi Devi is a senior World Championship medalist in Sanda.
• Option D is Incorrect because Pooja Kadian won India's first senior World Wushu Championship gold in 2017.

bihar_questions.qe: Which organization is responsible for setting up the Space Gallery and Innovation Centre at Darbhanga Planetarium?
bihar_questions.qh: दरभंगा प्लैनेटेरियम में स्पेस गैलरी और इनोवेशन सेंटर स्थापित करने की जिम्मेदारी किस संगठन की है?
oe: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
oh: राष्ट्रीय शैक्षिक अनुसंधान एवं प्रशिक्षण परिषद (NCERT)
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because ISRO experts inspected the site and the project is being executed under ISRO’s technical support.
• Option B is Incorrect because DST is not involved in this space‑related infrastructure.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Education does not act as the nodal agency for ISRO projects.
• Option D is Incorrect because NCERT focuses on curriculum, not space galleries.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Tenth Schedule of the Indian Constitution, on which ground does an independently elected member of a Legislative Assembly or Council face disqualification?
bihar_questions.qh: भारतीय संविधान की दसवीं अनुसूची के तहत, किसी विधान सभा या विधान परिषद के निर्दलीय निर्वाचित सदस्य को किस आधार पर अयोग्य घोषित कर दिया जाता है?
oe: If they join any political party after the election
If they abstain from voting in any general legislative session
If they fail to take oath within six months of election
If they form an informal alliance with other independent members
oh: यदि वे चुनाव के बाद किसी राजनीतिक दल में शामिल हो जाते हैं
यदि वे किसी सामान्य विधायी सत्र में मतदान से अनुपस्थित रहते हैं
यदि वे चुनाव के छह महीने के भीतर शपथ लेने में विफल रहते हैं
यदि वे अन्य निर्दलीय सदस्यों के साथ अनौपचारिक गठबंधन बनाते हैं
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because under Article 191(2) and the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution, an independently elected member of a legislature is disqualified if they join any political party after their election.
• Option B is Incorrect because mere absence without whip violation does not attract Tenth Schedule provisions.
• Option C is Incorrect because failure to take oath within six months does not fall under Tenth Schedule anti-defection rules.
• Option D is Incorrect because forming an informal alliance or extending external support without taking formal party membership does not trigger disqualification under the Tenth Schedule.

bihar_questions.qe: What percentage range of India's total makhana (fox nut) production is contributed by the state of Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: भारत के कुल मखाना (फॉक्स नट) उत्पादन में बिहार राज्य का योगदान कितना प्रतिशत है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Bihar accounts for 85% to 90% of India's total makhana production, covering over 35,000 hectares across the Mithilanchal, Seemanchal, and Kosi regions.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bihar's share is significantly higher than 50-55%.
• Option B is Incorrect because 65-70% underestimates Bihar's dominant contribution to national makhana yields.
• Option D is Incorrect because 35-40% is factually inaccurate.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which initiative has an MoU been signed between the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways and the Bihar Government to utilize excavated river silt in National Highway construction?
bihar_questions.qh: सड़क परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय और बिहार सरकार के बीच राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग निर्माण में खोदी गई नदी की गाद (सिल्ट) का उपयोग करने के लिए किस पहल के तहत समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए गए हैं?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways signed an MoU with the Bihar Government to undertake scientific desilting under the 'Nadi Sanjivani' initiative, utilizing silt in ongoing and future National Highway projects.
• Option B is Incorrect because 'Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali' is Bihar's flagship climate resilience and water conservation campaign.
• Option C is Incorrect because 'Setu Bharatam' aims to make all national highways free of railway level crossings.
• Option D is Incorrect because 'Nadi Abhyudaya' is a fictitious name in this context.

bihar_questions.qe: In which sports complex is Bihar's first World Athletics Class-1 synthetic track being constructed?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार का पहला विश्व एथलेटिक्स क्लास-1 सिंथेटिक ट्रैक किस खेल परिसर में निर्मित किया जा रहा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Bihar is setting up its first World Athletics Class-1 synthetic track at the Pataliputra Sports Complex in Kankarbagh, Patna, jointly developed by the Sports Department and Bihar State Sports Authority.
• Option A is Incorrect because Moin-ul-Haq Stadium is primarily a cricket stadium under redevelopment in Patna.
• Option C is Incorrect because Rajgir Sports Complex recently hosted the Women's Asian Champions Trophy but is not the location for this Class-1 track.
• Option D is Incorrect because Mithilesh Stadium is a police ground located in Gaya.

bihar_questions.qe: Which cultural institution was named the world's most visited museum in 2025 according to the TEA Global Experience Index report?
bihar_questions.qh: टीईए ग्लोबल एक्सपीरियंस इंडेक्स रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, 2025 में दुनिया का सबसे अधिक देखा जाने वाला संग्रहालय कौन सा सांस्कृतिक संस्थान बना?
oe: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Palace Museum (Forbidden City) in Beijing, China, recorded 19 million visitors in 2025, ranking as the world's most visited museum in the TEA Global Experience Index.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Louvre Museum in Paris recorded 9.05 million visitors, ranking lower on the index.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York did not hold the top position.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Vatican Museums were not ranked as the top visited museum in the report.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Bihar Renewable Energy Policy 2025, what target capacity has the Bihar government set for renewable energy generation to be achieved by the year 2030?
bihar_questions.qh: 'बिहार नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा नीति 2025' के तहत बिहार सरकार ने वर्ष 2030 तक कितनी नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा उत्पादन क्षमता का लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because under the Bihar Renewable Energy Policy 2025, the state aims to reach 24 GW of renewable energy capacity and 6 GWh of energy storage capacity by 2030.
• Option B is Incorrect because 18 GW is lower than the official policy commitment of 24 GW pitched during the India Renewable Energy Summit 2026.
• Option C is Incorrect because 30 GW exceeds the state's stated target for 2030.
• Option D is Incorrect because 12 GW represents only half of the target capacity approved by the Bihar state government.

bihar_questions.qe: What official National Expressway designation has been assigned to the proposed Patna-Purnia Greenfield Expressway in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में प्रस्तावित पटना-पूर्णिया ग्रीनफील्ड एक्सप्रेसवे को कौन सा आधिकारिक राष्ट्रीय एक्सप्रेसवे क्रमांक प्रदान किया गया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the proposed six-lane Patna-Purnia Greenfield Expressway is officially designated as National Expressway-9 (NE-9).
• Option A is Incorrect because NE-5 corresponds to a different highway corridor in the national network.
• Option C is Incorrect because NE-12 is not assigned to the Patna-Purnia stretch.
• Option D is Incorrect because NE-7 does not refer to Bihar's first greenfield national expressway.
